text.en:

by Act Numbered Two thousand seven hundred and twenty-seven for the general expenses of the Insular
Government during the fiscal year ending December thirty-first, nineteen. hundred and eighteen, the following
sums to cover the deficits in the apropriations pertaining to said year made for certain Bureaus of the Insular
